verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own export paths: transcripts, summaries and metadata can go to an Amazon S3 bucket, and transcripts can sync to Google Drive for backup. That is a real first-party way to get data out. However, no evidence says which file formats are used, whether the export covers everything (audio/video recordings, action items, channels), or that a bulk account-level takeout exists for leaving the service. Missing for 10: documented open export formats, complete account-wide export including recordings, explicit offboarding/takeout flow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export transcripts, summaries, and metadata directly to your Amazon S3 bucket.
Sync transcripts and meeting content directly to your Google Drive for easy access and backup.
Otter automatically sends transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata to Airtable.
